description.value: Stonesedge Kitchen is a modern sports bar in Whistler Village operated by the Gibbons Hospitality Group, blending elevated comfort food — centred on high-quality burgers — with craft cocktails, frozen drinks, and boozy milkshakes, plus an unexpected caviar offering. It runs weekly themed nights and is a lively gathering spot in the heart of the village. For a touring cyclist rolling into Whistler, it offers a full sit-down meal and cocktail experience steps from the village centre.
